content: {"decision":"Reject as proposed; enforce validation and authorization before release.","risks":["Caller-supplied lenient policies at fetch time can bypass acceptance criteria or reinterpret stored results.","Saving raw generator output as succeeded conflates generation completion with validated success.","Tenant authentication alone does not establish authorization to create, fetch, or change each workflow.","Untrusted generator output may cross storage, rendering, or downstream execution boundaries without appropriate checks."],"required_changes":["Bind a server-approved, versioned validation policy to the workflow at creation; enforce mandatory checks that callers cannot weaken.","Treat any permitted policy change as an authorized, audited revision requiring revalidation, not a fetch-time override.","Separate generated, validating, succeeded, and failed states; publish success only after validation of the exact stored output against the bound policy.","Enforce tenant and object-level authorization on every operation; scope result storage and caches accordingly.","Keep fetch read-only and return persisted validation status; control access to unvalidated output and apply safe handling at each downstream boundary."],"evidence_needed":["API contracts and policy-selection rules showing rejection of unauthorized overrides.","State-transition and retry/concurrency tests proving validation cannot be skipped and output cannot change after validation.","Cross-tenant and same-tenant unauthorized-object access tests, including cached results.","Negative tests for invalid generator output, plus records linking output identity, policy version, validation outcome, and authorized changes."]}
